meta.modeled: The repository is a curriculum and governance repository, not runtime software. This map models the process that governs it: how private schedule authority, curriculum policy and learner work become (or fail to become) verified Phase 0 evidence.
meta.thesis: defense-foundations is a one-learner training pipeline with an evidence firewall. A private authority publishes a hash-stamped schedule projection into the repository; curriculum policy routes the learner through parallel Python, Rust, agent and warfare tracks; the learner builds Project 0, a paired Python/Rust file-statistics CLI; observed command output becomes phase0-proof.v1 receipts; and a fail-closed validator decides whether any receipt can reach the P0 gate review. Calendar state, endr work and historical coursework are blocked from counting. Today the firewall and validators are built and tested, while both Project 0 CLIs are stubs and no receipt exists.

tour.title: Authority lives outside the repo
tour.narration: Every date, count and capacity figure starts in a private vault: a Phase Config and a sealed manifest. The repository never decides schedule facts. It receives them from a publisher script and must match them byte for byte.

tour.title: A hash-stamped projection is published
tour.narration: The exporter writes one JSON projection and 14 generated blocks into repository docs. Each block carries the projection's SHA-256, so any drift between the copies is detectable.

tour.title: Policy routes the learner
tour.narration: AGENTS.md sets precedence. route-v2 fixes the P0–P12 graph with only P0 active. The parallel policy runs five tracks at once, one course each. Start Here defines checkpoints Z0–Z9 and the Project 0 contract.

tour.title: One human operator
tour.narration: Six inputs converge on the learner, who is the only actor able to create evidence. The phone view renders the projection read-only; its scratch note is explicitly not evidence.

tour.title: Project 0: the only product code
tour.narration: A wc-style CLI in Python and Rust against six shared fixtures. Today file_stats prints a greeting in 6 lines and hello-stats multiplies two numbers in 13. The fixtures exist only as a table in prose.

tour.title: The evidence firewall
tour.narration: Only observed commands become phase0-proof.v1 receipts. Calendar state, endr work and historical coursework are refused by rule. The receipts directory is empty: there are no tests to observe yet.

tour.title: Fail-closed verification
tour.narration: The integrity validator re-derives the projection from vault sources, checks marker hashes and the PWA contract, and rejects any receipt with zero tests or unobserved output. It imports code from the private vault to do so.

tour.title: The gate is starved
tour.narration: The P0 gate accepts only verified receipts and CI evidence. None exist: no receipts, no workflow, no tests. About 1,200 lines of validator and test code guard 19 lines of Project 0 code. The next unit of value is one real test in file_stats.
